On iPhone and iPad, Theodolite uses a viewfinder format, uniting the device sensors (GPS, magnetometer, gyro, accelerometer) and camera. summary.label:
The application was born out of personal frustration with finding a parking spot. There are quite a few solo bays in London, but finding them can sometimes be a problem.

This application will assist you in finding solo bays near you or at a specified location.

PLEASE NOTE that it is only for parking in London, UK.

Different Boroughs have different parking rules. We have provided details on this as well.

All boroughs are covered!!
